challenge: Mild, dry Monday in New Buffalo (~53°F morning to ~60°F afternoon, breezy up to 14 mph). Yesterday was upper body, so today is an easy lower-body dumbbell block plus a walk with a few light jog intervals. Keep it moderate until WHOOP recovery is confirmed.
items: Easy 5 min warm-up (leg swings, bodyweight squats, hip circles)
DB reverse lunge 2x10 each leg @ 12 lb
35 min walk, early afternoon (~60°F), with 4 x 1 min easy jog
Total Gym core: 2 x 12 crunch pulls (optional)
